thread:
nina: FYI we got a compliance hit from SOC: rebuild requested for base-image after libssl/glibc CVE grouping. Need a short plan that covers RBAC, KMS signing, audit plumbing, and quick rollback.
jorge: Copy. We should avoid creating long-lived principals. Proposed: ephemeral builder role + KMS envelope signing via HSM/KMS alias.
tess: Also require attestation in registry metadata and runtime mitigations (seccomp profile + non-root user). We should document the exact selector for canary.
infrastructure-bot: New pipeline job created: `rebuild/trigger/2881234567` by nina.
jorge: RBAC outline: 1) Create role `image-rebuilder-window-2881234567` 2) Attach only iam:PassRole (to assume builder) and ecr:PutImage to canary repo 3) KMS:Grant to allow kms:Sign and kms:GenerateDataKeyWithContext with Condition: aws:RequestTag/rollout=gl-rebase
tess: Can we scope the KMS grant to a KMS key alias rather than key-id? prefer alias 'alias/image-signer-prod' so we can rotate underlying key without changing role.
sre-oncall: For on-call safety: the grant TTL should be 90m with auto-revoke at end of window. I'll script revocation into the playbook. Also add a watch that pages if cosign errors > 2 within 10m.
jorge: Signing flow (cosign):
```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 
cosign sign --key k8s://keystore/alias/image-signer-prod 
--annotations build_id=2881234567,rebuilt_by=nina 
registry.company.com/base:rebuild-2881234567
```
Note: cosign will use KMS envelope; we must ensure the KMS grant allows Sign only. No raw key export.
tess: Registry layout: push only to `staging-repo/canary/base`. CI will run attestation and push SBOM as an OCI artifact. We must ensure read-only perms for production repo until post-rollout.
jorge: Audit requirements: every sign/push must emit structured JSON to CloudTrail + internal audit-sink. Fields: principal, role_arn, key_alias, image_digest, build_id. We'll tag events with `compliance:gl-rebase` for downstream filters.
nina: Pre-checks: vulnerability scan pass for SBOM, cosign successful, KMS grant active, ephemeral role issued. Failing any pre-check -> abort before canary.
sre-oncall: Runtime canary gating: deploy to 2 clusters (canary1, canary2) at 5% each. Watch metrics: 1) 5xx rate, 2) latency p95, 3) memory+OOMs. Abort if 5xx delta > 0.3% or p95 +20% for > 5m.
jorge: Also add a KV-cache warm metric: if cache miss rate > 10% after 3 minutes -> abort. That avoids cold-cache regressions.
tess: For RBAC minimalism, builder pods will use projected service account tokens with audience limited to 'image-builder' and bound to the ephemeral IAM role via IRSA. No cluster-wide perms.
nina: Who will run the actual image build and sign? jorge: I'll kick the build and run cosign. nina: I'll own rollback decisions and notify product & legal if needed.
sre-oncall: I'll create a quick revocation script and a one-click rollback job that reverts image tag to previous. Also wire PagerDuty escalation list.
infra-bot: Pipeline `rebuild/trigger/2881234567` scheduled for 2026-04-02T03:00:00Z.
jorge: Post-deploy tests: smoke + qps soak for 15m, chaos-lite (pod kill on 1% of canary pods) to ensure graceful degradation. Document expected success thresholds.
tess: Security manual step: confirm cosign output and registry attestation hash in the runbook. We should also snapshot the KMS key's key-rotation state and record it in the audit.
nina: Great. Can someone PR the RBAC and KMS grant templates? jorge: I'll open PR and tag tess for review.
sre-oncall: I'll add monitoring dashboards and the self-service revoke job.
jorge: ack
tess: ack
sre-oncall: ack
nina: thanks everyone, I'll circulate the single-run runbook and attach the PR links here once ready.
